DAILY SYNTHESIS Today's session told a tale of two markets: equities fractured along sector lines as semiconductors absorbed punishing losses while defensives and financials held firm, and crypto carved out an independent rally that defied the equity tape. The divergence between digital assets and chip-heavy tech is the dominant narrative thread heading into tomorrow. Watch whether crypto inflows sustain and whether semiconductor weakness finds a floor or continues to drag the broader tech complex lower.
